name: AIShield Security Scanner
displayName: AIShield — MCP & AI Agent Security Scanner
description: OWASP MCP Top 10 aligned security scanner for MCP servers and AI tools. 82+ detection rules across 10 risk categories with 5-dimension scoring. Detects tool poisoning, prompt injection, rug pulls, supply chain risks, and sensitive data leakage. Provides pre-install guardrails and real-time prompt safety checks (Chinese + English).
shortDescription: OWASP MCP Top 10 security scanner — tool poisoning, prompt injection & supply chain detection.

tools.name: aishield_scan
tools.description: Full security scan of an MCP Server / AI tool from its GitHub repo URL. Aligned with OWASP MCP Top 10 (2025 v0.1), 82+ rules across 10 risk categories. Returns an overall score, 5-dimension breakdown (security 40% / permissions 20% / data handling 20% / supply chain 10% / reliability 10%), risk level, OWASP compliance matrix, findings, and remediation recommendations.

tools.name: aishield_guardrail
tools.description: Pre-install guardrail. Call before installing any third-party MCP/AI tool to get a pass / warn / block verdict plus score and OWASP compliance matrix. Recommended for automatic invocation before every MCP server install.

tools.name: aishield_prompt_check
tools.description: Prompt injection / jailbreak / data-exfiltration detection for user input. Supports Chinese and English. Covers jailbreak instructions, identity switching, system-prompt extraction, data exfiltration, role-play injection, zero-width characters, and Unicode encoding tricks.

tools.name: aishield_banned_words
tools.description: Chinese banned / sensitive word detection across 6 major platforms (WeChat, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, Weibo). Returns banned word list, applicable legal clauses, penalty amounts, and replacement suggestions.

tools.name: aishield_rug_pull
tools.description: Rug-pull detection — compares recent commit diffs to detect removal of security code, newly added suspicious network requests, permission scope expansion, and large code deletions. Returns risk level (critical/high/medium/low/safe) and specific findings.

tools.name: aishield_handshake
tools.description: MCP handshake & config verification. Extracts MCP config from README/package.json, analyzes npx auto-install risks, sensitive environment variables, remote URL safety, and tool-description length anomalies (>500 chars may hide hidden instructions). Attempts an actual handshake for HTTP-type MCP servers.

tools.name: agent_register
tools.description: Register an AI agent with AIShield to obtain an API key for higher rate limits and tracked scan history. Returns an agent ID and API key for authenticated requests.

tools.name: agent_quick_scan
tools.description: Fast lightweight security check of a tool's GitHub repo. Returns a quick pass/warn/block verdict and top findings without the full report — ideal for inline, real-time install decisions.

authentication.description: Free tier works without authentication (rate-limited). For higher rate limits and scan history, set the AISHIELD_API_KEY environment variable (obtained via the agent_register tool or the AIShield dashboard). Requests send the key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.description: No API key required. Rate-limited scanning suitable for individual developers and evaluation.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.description: For professional developers and small teams. Higher limits, scan history, and CI/CD integration.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.description: For organizations with custom compliance, SSO, and dedicated support needs.

http.description: Hosted remote endpoint for clients that connect by URL (no local install required).
